title: DCP PGM Fidelity Window-Threshold Audit: Exact Bhattacharyya Convolution Formula, Flat-Window Optimality, and Contiguous Support Copy Lower Bounds

theorems.name: Exact Bhattacharyya Convolution Formula for K-Copy Covariant PGM Success
theorems.statement: For any shift-covariant state |psi_s> = sum_u sqrt(p_u) omega_q^(-s u) |u> on Z_q, the K-copy Pretty Good Measurement success probability equals Tr(sqrt(rho_avg^(K)))^2 / q = (1/q) * (sum_{m=0}^{q-1} sqrt(W_K(m)))^2, where W_K = p^(*K) is the K-fold cyclic convolution of p on Z_q.

theorems.name: Support-Rank Upper Bound and Flat-Window Optimality
theorems.statement: For any K >= 1, P_PGM^succ(K; p) <= |supp(W_K)| / q, with equality at K = 1 (P_PGM^succ(1; p) = R / q) if and only if p_u = 1/R on its R-element support.

theorems.name: Contiguous Window Support-Growth Law and Copy Complexity Lower Bound
theorems.statement: For any Fourier profile p with contiguous support {0, 1, ..., R-1} in Z_q (2 <= R <= q), |supp(W_K)| = min(q, K(R-1) + 1), forcing P_PGM^succ(K; p) <= min(1, (K(R-1) + 1)/q) and K >= ceil((tau*q - 1)/(R - 1)) to reach success probability >= tau.
